title: ML / AI Engineer
summary: Data professional with nearly 4 years of experience building automated data pipelines and analytical solutions, now transitioning into Machine Learning and AI Engineering. Demonstrated ability to design end-to-end workflows from raw data ingestion through feature engineering, statistical analysis, and model preparation. Currently completing intensive ML/AI training (CodeCademy ML/AI Engineer certification completed; IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate and LogicMojo batch training in progress through 2026) with hands-on experience in supervised learning algorithms, model evaluation metrics, and scalable data infrastructure.

tailored_bullets: Designed automated data pipelines using Python (Pandas, SQLAlchemy) — from PostgreSQL ingestion to multi-table integration, preparing clean datasets for ML model consumption
Applied feature engineering techniques: temporal feature extraction, date deltas, categorical encoding (one-hot), and business aggregations — core preprocessing for machine learning workflows

Conducted structured Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) including missing value detection, distribution analysis, correlation heatmaps (Pearson, Spearman), and outlier identification — critical steps in ML model preparation
Consolidated multi-source data (MySQL, PostgreSQL, APIs) into unified analytics infrastructure supporting downstream model training pipelines
